title: Annabin Duwatsu Masu Sassaka
intro: A cikin hamadar Larabawa mai tsauri, wani mutum ya bayyana a tsakanin mutanen da aka san su da ƙwarewarsu ta ban mamaki. Gidajensu sun tashi daga dutse mai ƙarfi, duk da haka zukatansu sun fi tauri fiye da tsaunukan da suka sassaka. Wani manzon Allah ya zo da wata alama mai ban mamaki guda ɗaya - amma girman kai da rashin biyayya sun haifar da sakamako mai sauri da ban tsoro. Za ku iya gano bawan da mutanensa suka zaɓi halaka fiye da shiriya?
clues: An aiko ni a matsayin mai gargaɗi ga mutanena, ina kiran su zuwa ga bauta wa Allah ɗaya tilo.
Mutanena suna zaune a tsakanin tsaunuka masu ban mamaki, suna sassaka gidaje masu kyau a gefen tsaunuka.
Raƙumi mai ban mamaki ya fito daga dutse mai ƙarfi a lokacin addu'ata, wata alama ce bayyananniya daga Mai Iko Dukka.
Na gaya wa mutanena su raba ruwan da wannan rakumin ba tare da sun cutar da shi ba.
Mutanena sun yi makirci a kan raƙumin suka kuma sare shi, suka rufe halakarsu.
Girgizar ƙasa mai ban tsoro ta afka wa mutanena, suka faɗi a gidajensu babu motsi.

trial.label: Menene ma'anar gwajin?
options: Raƙumi mai ban mamaki da aka yi masa kakkausar murya
Gina babban jirgi a tsakiyar izgili
Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai ƙuna
trial.answer: Raƙumi mai ban mamaki da aka yi masa kakkausar murya

location.label: Menene babban abin da ke cikinsa?
options: Raƙumi da ya fito daga dutse
Dutsen da aka rataye a sama
location.answer: Raƙumi da ya fito daga dutse

outcome.label: Menene makomarsu ta ƙarshe?
options: An nutsar da shi cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai ƙarfi
Biranensu sun lalace da umarnin Allah
Iska mai zafi ta ƙone ta

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
